title: Botanical focus pull
description: Three sculptural calla lilies resolve at different depths as the focal plane moves through an oxblood still life.
useCase: Direct attention through a layered editorial scene or preview a camera's focus control with recognizable subjects.
interaction: Select a flower or move the focus rail.
reducedMotion: Subject selection and manual focus changes are immediate. The normal 260 ms focus pull is removed; there is no idle animation.
limitations: Original vector botanical artwork at three authored depth planes. CSS Gaussian blur approximates defocus; this is not a thin-lens solver or aperture-shaped bokeh renderer. The distance scale is illustrative.
look: Deep oxblood vignette backdrop with three ivory calla lilies on green stems at different depths, one sharp and two blurred, plus a thin focus rail.
motion: Clicking a lily pulls focus to it, easing every flower's blur to its depth offset over 260 ms ease-out; dragging the focus rail changes blur directly.
adapt: Defocus is the inline `filter` blur on each `sf-botanical-focus-plane`, computed as `Math.abs(flower.depth - depth) * 0.075` px and eased by its 260 ms transition. Replace the lily paths and the `subjects` array (position, size, angle, `depth`) with your own layered artwork.
